cohort: The participants were 105 Dutch patients diagnosed with paroxysmal nocturnal hemoglobinuria (PNH).
finding: The majority of PNH patients benefited from eculizumab treatment when adhering to Dutch PNH guideline indications, showing various levels of hematological response and quality of life improvements, with no maternal/fetal deaths or thromboembolic events observed in pregnant patients.
followup_time: 12 months (for initial response criteria), with stable response observed during long-term follow-up
